$comment: Publication policy for the generated public references. Read by scripts/gen-cli.mjs and scripts/gen-config.mjs through scripts/doc-policy.mjs. See ../README.md for the rationale and for how to add an entry.

rewrites.why: The licence commands stay public, their mechanism does not.
Document what the command shows, not how it is stored.
rewrites.replacement: $1shows your licence status, edition and expiry date

rewrites.why: Document the outcome, not the token format.
rewrites.pattern: (timon license install <file>\s+)validates then installs the JWT

rewrites.why: Document the outcome, not the exchange with our infrastructure.
rewrites.pattern: (timon license activate <key>\s+)exchanges the key with the license server, then installs the JWT

forbidden.why: Licence signature algorithm. Ed25519 itself stays publishable: plugin packages and webhook formats are signed with it, and their guides say so.
Private site administration commands are not customer documentation.
Private licence administration routes are not customer interfaces.
